briefdescription.para: GCH-05: GPU unavailable → silent CPU fallback; no error returned.
GCH-06: CPU always available regardless of GPU state.
GCH-07: CPU and GPU results are consistent within kBackendAccuracyTolerance.
GCH-08: Backend selection decision is fast (within kBackendSelectionBudget).
GCH-09: Insert + bbox query round-trip: inserted point is found.
GCH-10: Bounding-box query returns all entries whose MBR overlaps.
GCH-11: Query with non-overlapping bbox returns empty result set.
GCH-12: isGeometryError() covers all geometry-validity error codes.
GCH-13: Intersect join completeness: all qualifying pairs returned.
GCH-14: Contains semantics: B fully inside A is reported; partial outside is not.
GCH-15: Invalid geometry in input → JOIN_INVALID_INPUT (not silent skip).
GCH-16: isBackendFallback() is true only for GPU_FALLBACK_TO_CPU.
Phase 4 geo module contract-hardening focused tests (GCH-01..GCH-16).

detaileddescription.para: Validates every invariant defined in include/geo/geo_api_contract.h using deterministic, self-contained mock fixtures. No GPU, GDAL, or real network I/O is used.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: GCH-01 Valid WGS84 Point geometry → accepted. GCH-02 Null (empty) coordinate array → GEOMETRY_INVALID. GCH-03 Out-of-bounds longitude (> +180) → COORDINATE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS. GCH-04 Out-of-bounds latitude (< -90) → COORDINATE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.

GCH-05 GPU unavailable → automatic silent fallback to CPU (no error). GCH-06 CPU always available (even when GPU is present). GCH-07 GPU and CPU results are consistent within kBackendAccuracyTolerance. GCH-08 Backend selection latency within kBackendSelectionBudget.

GCH-09 Insert + query round-trip: inserted point is found by bbox query. GCH-10 Bounding-box query returns all overlapping entries. GCH-11 Query with non-overlapping bbox returns empty result set. GCH-12 isGeometryError() covers all geometry-validity error codes.

GCH-13 Intersect join completeness: all qualifying pairs returned. GCH-14 Contains semantics: B fully inside A is reported, B partially outside is not. GCH-15 Invalid geometry in input → JOIN_INVALID_INPUT (not silent skip). GCH-16 isBackendFallback() is true only for GPU_FALLBACK_TO_CPU.
